Alex (CS): Quick weekly check-in for Helix dedicated pool.
Alex (CS): Observed sustained saturation Wed 18:30-20:15 PST during their ad campaign; spike in queue depth.
capacity-bot: 7d summary: GPU hours=3420; avg/day=489; peak utilization=98% (3.2h); p95 util=82%.
capacity-bot: queue depth: avg=1.1, median=0, spike=14 at 2025-11-12T18:42:13Z. p95 latency (token): 120ms vs baseline 85ms. error_rate=0.3% (mostly transient OOM/reschedule).
Priya (Eng): Thanks. Do we know if these are sustained requests or short surges? :thinking: 
Alex (CS): Mostly short bursts tied to batch job windows + interactive traffic. Campaign run at 18:30 triggered many small parallel requests.
Marc (Dedicated): Looking at node allocation — headroom was ~1.5 GPUs at the time. Autoscale didn't add due to cooldown + queue size threshold.
Priya (Eng): Can we lower the scale-up threshold to queue_depth>=4 for this pool? That would have triggered earlier.
Marc (Dedicated): Yeah we can try threshold=4 and cooldown 60s. Will need confirmation on cost impact.
Lisa (Customer): We're running a marketing push next Tue 18:00-19:30 PST, likely similar pattern. Can we get a temporary buffer?
Alex (CS): Proposed mitigations:
- enable burst_capacity: +2 GPUs during campaign window
- pre-warm KV cache for common prefixes
- reduce batch window from 20ms -> 10ms for latency-sensitive route
- promote q4_quantized variant for Helix-chat to reduce memory
Priya (Eng): I'll open a small runbook change and canary the lower batch window tonight in staging.
Marc (Dedicated): I'll patch autoscaler threshold + set scheduled burst for Tue. Estimate +2 GPUs for 2h => ~4 GPU-hours extra (cost impact ~+$120).
capacity-bot: Scheduled action: burst helix_pool +2GPUs 2025-11-18T18:00:00Z -> 2025-11-18T20:00:00Z (pending approval).
Alex (CS): Approve the scheduled burst? :thumbsup: if yes.
Lisa (Customer): :thumbsup: Approved.
Priya (Eng): I'll post update when canary is green.
Alex (CS): OK will follow up in next weekly. Action owners: Priya (autoscale + batch canary), Marc (allocate burst + reserve nodes), Alex (coord + postmortem if needed).
